title: mammea anastomosans
intro: Mammea anastomosans, commonly known as Mamey Sapote, is a tropical fruit-bearing tree native to Central and South America. It is valued for its edible fruit, which is rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mammea anastomosans include its ability to regulate blood sugar levels, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Mammea anastomosans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
